lines.en: Gun in hand, I walk slowly.
The ammo belt rattles at my waist.

lines.zh: 我的靴底粘着下界的灰。
lines.en: Nether ash sticks to my boot soles.

lines.zh: 我把枪口抬起来又放下。
lines.en: I lift the muzzle, then lower it.
The Nether stone is hot underfoot.
I walk and look for cover.
My hide dried out long ago.
I walk along the lava's edge.
I can count what rounds I have left.
I move to another spot.
Bones grind inside the skin.
I shuffle a few steps more.
I steady the gun's body.
The belt hangs and sways.
Six blocks. That's two bursts.
There is little worth guarding in the Nether.
I check the action.
I start counting my rounds.
My sweat dried up long ago.
I stand like a post.

lines.zh: 周围的热气让枪身发烫。
lines.en: The heat makes the gun's body hot.
I hold this lava passage.
You are in my sights.
Stand right there.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，就是一片弹雨。
lines.en: One lift of my arm means a storm of bullets.
You are slower than a bullet.
I am looking at your chest.
You have no gun.
There is no wall between us.
Stone won't stop armour-piercing rounds.
This is no use at all.

lines.zh: 下界里没有安全的地方。
lines.en: There is no safe place in the Nether.
The hit knocks me back a step.
The gun got knocked.
I level it again.
There is little left to bleed.
I can still hold the gun.

lines.zh: 这一下不影响我扣扳机。
lines.en: That does not stop me pulling the trigger.
A few links came loose.
I steady the gun.
I do not fear this pain.
I keep aiming at you.

lines.zh: 我这死人的胃早就干了。
lines.en: A dead man's stomach dried up long ago.
What I lack is ammunition.
Don't wave food at a dead man.
I only watch the sights.
Put it down. It blocks my view.
The trigger is all I have hands for.
I shake my head.
Bring something else.
My stomach is long gone.
Keep standing there.
I shove you off with the stock.
The gun's body hits your ribs.
I plant my feet and raise the gun again.
You knocked me half a step off.
The belt snagged.
The sound we made was dull.
I step back to open the range.
You are pressed too close.
At this range the gun is awkward.
Clear the field of fire.
Ammunition can be shared.
You hold that side; I hold this.
When the belt runs out, change it.
Do not point that at me.
Neither of us needs sleep.
Crossfire is what stops them.
Do not waste rounds.

lines.zh: 换弹的时候要有人看着。
lines.en: Someone must watch while you reload.
Companions are rare in the Nether.
Keep holding this spot.
I stoop and grab it.
Can this be ammunition?
I weigh it in my hand.
Into the pouch it goes.
Not what I need.
I fling it back.

lines.zh: 这个弹壳我还能再用一次。
lines.en: This casing can be reloaded once.
I work it into a gap in the belt.
There are a few more on the ground.
Keep it. Do not waste it.
Target in range.
I pull the action. It's chambered.
The belt starts to feed.

lines.zh: 我把准星压在你的胸口。
lines.en: My sights sit on your chest.
Stand and do not sway.
I am aiming.
Your shoulder is exposed.
This range is just right.
The muzzle is on you.
In position.
I count in my head.
Counting one.
Counting two.
Counting three.
Fire now.
I track you with the muzzle low.

lines.zh: 你绕到柱子后，我就换位。
lines.en: Behind a pillar, and I reposition.
My steps are steady.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，我算到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, I calculate it.
Bursts are cheaper than spraying.
I wait for your head to show.
The line of fire is at your flank.
You are crouching too low.
I shift half a step for angle.
Three steps and a pause. I wait.
Any closer and I open fire.
Shell casings are all over the ground.
The barrel is hot now.
You have backed to the lava.
That is a dead angle.
I wait for you to turn side-on.
Gunfire carries a long way.
I have swapped belts.
This position is good.
Do not raise your head.
A burst goes out.
I swing the barrel across at you.
The fire keeps your head down.

lines.zh: 我把你顶到岩浆壁上了。
lines.en: Your back is against the lava wall.
I swap to a fresh belt.
Casings clatter down.
That round went past you.
I am on you again.
You have a few new holes.
The barrel is smoking.
Short, sharp bursts.
I fall back and reposition.
You are still standing?
Another volley.
Half a belt left.
You need a new place to hide.
Do not assume I will miss.
The line of fire never breaks.

lines.zh: 我从下界的雾里端枪走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the Nether haze with the gun up.
The belt clanks once first.
I halt and raise the gun.
The air gains a smell of powder.
I lean against a stone.
The muzzle points your way.
I am here, and I brought the belt.
The gravel sounds under my boots.

lines.zh: 我从火墙后面拉响枪机。
lines.en: The action clicks behind the wall of fire.

lines.zh: 一具干硬的尸体，端着枪。
lines.en: A dried corpse, holding a gun.
The action clicks.
Are you set.
I level the gun.
I see something moving.
The fire heats my gun, and I pull back.
I nearly lost the gun on landing.
No using a gun underwater.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的弹链炸断了。
lines.en: The blast snapped my ammo belt.
I took a round myself.
This light stiffens my fingers.
Too starved to pull the trigger.
A spark jumped along my belt.
There is nothing to aim at here.
